title: AI conversation
description: One conversation from ai_normalized: context growth, credits per call and tool calls. Opened from the AI tools overview, or set the conversation variable.

panels.title: Conversation
panels.description: The conversation in the conversation variable. Project is the repo and branch, known for VS Code only. Times are in the timezone variable.

queries.query: SELECT t."conversation", p.project AS "project", t."tool", t."model", t."started", t."ended", t."hours" FROM (SELECT ai_conversation_id AS "conversation", MAX(ai_source) AS "tool", FIRST_VALUE(ai_model ORDER BY ai_total_tokens DESC) AS "model", to_char(MIN((to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')), '%d.%m.%Y %H:%M') AS "started", to_char(MAX((to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')), '%d.%m.%Y %H:%M') AS "ended", ROUND((MAX(_timestamp) - MIN(_timestamp)) / 3600000000.0, 1) AS "hours" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background' AND ai_conversation_id = '$conversation' GROUP BY ai_conversation_id ORDER BY "conversation") t LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(gen_ai_conversation_id, copilot_chat_session_id) AS cid, MAX(replace(regexp_replace(github_copilot_git_repository, '^.*/', ''), '.git', '') || COALESCE(' · ' || github_copilot_git_branch, '')) AS project FROM "vscode_copilot_raw" WHERE github_copilot_git_repository IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cid) p ON p.cid = t."conversation" ORDER BY t."conversation"

panels.title: Average context per call
panels.description: Average input context per model call: uncached input, cache read and cache write.

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(((CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' THEN ai_input_tokens - COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0) ELSE ai_input_tokens END) + COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0))), 0) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background' AND ai_conversation_id = '$conversation'

panels.title: Context per call
panels.description: Input context of each model call, by token type. Each call reads the conversation so far from the cache and writes only the new part. A tall cache write bar means the whole context was written again, usually because the cache expired during a pause of over 5 minutes.

queries.query: SELECT "call" AS "x_axis_1", SUM((CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' THEN ai_input_tokens - COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0) ELSE ai_input_tokens END)) AS "y_axis_1", 'Uncached input' AS "breakdown_1" FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY _timestamp) AS "call", (_timestamp - LAG(_timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY _timestamp)) / 60000000.0 AS "pause" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background' AND ai_conversation_id = '$conversation') GROUP BY "call" UNION ALL SELECT "call" AS "x_axis_1", SUM(COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0)) AS "y_axis_1", 'Cache read' AS "breakdown_1" FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY _timestamp) AS "call", (_timestamp - LAG(_timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY _timestamp)) / 60000000.0 AS "pause" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background' AND ai_conversation_id = '$conversation') GROUP BY "call" UNION ALL SELECT "call" AS "x_axis_1", SUM(COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) AS "y_axis_1", 'Cache write' AS "breakdown_1" FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY _timestamp) AS "call", (_timestamp - LAG(_timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY _timestamp)) / 60000000.0 AS "pause" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background' AND ai_conversation_id = '$conversation') GROUP BY "call" ORDER BY "x_axis_1"
